residual.note: A ~$750 owner reserve, referenced in the move-out relay's timing-boxed money step (src/domain/flows.ts, FlowStep.note) and in docs/WRIT-FLOW-ENGINE.md and docs/WRIT-ECONOMY.md, but never promoted to a facts.json object — it lives only as prose inside a flow step's note string, not as a governing number the engine reads.

The vacancy price-drop loop's $25/week figure, referenced in the same flow step's note string ("$25 off the ask each week it sits") and in docs/WRIT-FLOW-ENGINE.md's stress-test description, but not a named exported constant.

docs/WRIT-ECONOMY.md describes the founding fee rules as "management 8%, leasing one month, markup 10%" — the actual FOUNDING_ECONOMY in src/domain/economy.ts ships 7.5% management, three-quarters-of-a-month leasing, and 12.5% markup. The writ's prose and the code have drifted from each other; neither figure is any firm's real term, but they disagree with one another and nobody has reconciled them.
CAMPAIGN_INTAKE = 2 (src/domain/campaign.ts) — a private, unexported constant governing how many raw-intake items the Intro Campaign's second act deals when none is asked for explicitly.

The consequence engine's WEIGHT table ({ festering: 1, crisis: 4 }, src/domain/consequences.ts) — a private, unexported constant that sizes how much harm each severity band erodes a Patron's faith by.
